description: This file defines a caching system for the litellm library, including cache initialization, key generation, cache retrieval, addition, and management of various cache types such as Redis, S3, GCS, disk, and in-memory caches. It includes classes for cache handling, functions for enabling, updating, and disabling caches, and detailed methods for cache key management and caching logic.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: Class providing cache management including creation, key handling, retrieval, and storage across multiple cache backends.
